notes: Summary: Global OTA + concierge services. Heavy seasonal traffic; EU HQ (Barcelona). Looking to consolidate multilingual support stack into single inference layer.

Primary ask: real-time agent-assist (live suggestions + tool-call orchestration), automatic ticket summarization, locale-aware translation + tone (formal/informal by country), and predictable behavior during extreme spikes (flights delays, strikes).
Latency targets: agent_assist suggestions <200ms median, <400ms 95th during normal load; acceptable to increase to ~600ms for rare peaks if throughput preserved.
Throughput: baseline 1k concurrent agents, burst to 10k concurrent sessions during big disruptions (expect 6x baseline for ~3-6 hours).
Model preferences: open-model stack preferred (cost sensitivity) but willing to use Redwood-verified variants with quantization; need model pinning and fallback to smaller models for degraded mode.
Routing: must route by customer locale and legal residency -> EU traffic to EU region; fallback to nearest compatible model in event of region outage.

Security: SSO / SAML with SCIM, audit logs for agent prompts & model outputs, KMS integration for key custody. Data retention policy: 30 days for message cache, 24 months for audit logs (per EU compliance team).

Integration notes: heavy reliance on legacy GDS + custom booking APIs. Need tool-calling to: check booking, modify itinerary, issue voucher codes. Must constrain model access to only necessary fields (PII gating).
Quotes: 'If we can reduce average handle time by 20% during major delays, the ROI is immediate' — Head of CX (L. Moreno).
POC scope agreed: 2-week sandbox connecting 50 agents, 3 locales (en-GB, es-ES, fr-FR), simulated peak replay (historic delay event from 2024).
Risk flags: legal asks for data residency proof; procurement wants committed latency figures and a runbook for graceful degradation.
Commercial: procurement requested a dedicated capacity estimate + burst pricing. Want to see Optimize recommendations for batching/caching and quantization for ticketed workloads.
Action items: Redwood to deliver POC checklist + stress-test plan by 2026-03-09; SE to produce mapping of tool-calls and required auth scopes by 2026-03-11.
